note: ROMA Heating & Cooling boiler-maintenance invoice -> commercial, happy path. Narrative anchor: asserts warranty '' on a service invoice whose only footer reference is a 'See our Terms & Conditions' link with no warranty text -- a link is not a warranty statement. Also a scheduled-maintenance (not break/fix) document: the diagnosis is a list of inspections with no fault found, which is the case the diagnosis prompt's step 4 covers ('a finding of no fault is still a finding'). invoice_number keeps the printed '#' prefix ('#116412') because that is how the document prints it; asserted as-is so a future prompt change that starts stripping it is visible. payment_due_date 2024-11-05 is genuinely printed (DUE DATE Nov 05, 2024, terms 'Upon receipt'), not a default. service_address is the customer's 311 E 35th Ave, not ROMA's own 2800 Douglas Rd contact address. || NOT asserted here: diagnosis_solution, diagnosis_solution_zh_hant, recommendation, recommendation_zh_hant -- free-text summaries, reworded on every replicate (verified correct by eye across 3 runs: the diagnosis lists the boiler maintenance and the safety/gas-leak/CO/burner/venting/heat-exchanger/inducer inspections; the recommendation captures the printed line 'Both units are very old highly recommend to replace for safety' and does not restate the performed work); invoice_description (free text, excluded by standing rule). || service_address IS asserted. This invoice carries ONE customer address block and CU assigns the identical extraction (same spans, same 0.345/0.462 confidences) to either service_address or bill_to_address, never both -- so the service_address twins come back empty on roughly 7 runs in 10. The Bill To fallback backfills it, and value and routing are 10/10 stable across the n=10 audit on analyzer cd1e585c2f1f.
